search_queries: overlay compose rebase in anvil-graph-cache ARCHITECTURE
after merge how base differs from worktree snapshot

first_useful_action.note: ADR-105: shared write-once base per merge-base + live per-worktree overlay.

answer: After a merge, shared base-graph persistence (ADR-105, plans/decisions/105-shared-base-graph-persistence.md) differs from the old per-worktree snapshot (ADR-069) in storage layout, not trust model: one write-once, content-addressed base snapshot per repo per merge-base commit (magic ANVILGB1), composed at warm-start with a live per-worktree overlay of changed files (overlay.rs / rebase.rs / compose.rs), instead of one private ANVILGC1 postcard file per WorktreeKey. The base is read from git objects in a CLI subprocess (never a dirty working tree, never the resident daemon); each worktree still materialises its own petgraph — sharing is on disk only. crates/anvil-graph-cache/ARCHITECTURE.md "Persistence and worktrees" maps ANVILGC1 vs ANVILGB1 and the compose path. The old per-worktree path is kept permanently for topologies a base cannot cover. A merge that moves the merge-base retires the prior base via GC against live registered worktrees' merge-bases; restore still comes up stale and reconciles before certify. Keep anvil_validate_write; no GCTX tools or Decision Brief used as a gate.
